title: Uploaded PDF rejected: Expected a file with an application/pdf MIME type, but got unsupported MIME type 'None'
symptoms: Invalid file data: 'file_id'. Expected a file with an application/pdf MIME type, but got unsupported MIME type 'None'.
Upload succeeds but the file id fails when used as input_file
cause: Uploading raw bytes without a filename or content type stores the file with no MIME type, and the model input path refuses it.
fix: Upload with a filename and content type tuple and purpose user_data, then use the new file id.
affected: openai-python and other SDKs uploading bytes for PDF inputs, confirmed by maintainers 2026-09-10
